units.label: Add semantic-units grouping engine (groups module)
units.description: New src/groups/{agent,mod,prompt,store}.rs: resolves an agent CLI, enumerates/hashes hunks, builds and parses the grouping prompt, and persists results to groups.jsonl — the deterministic core the UI and CLI both build on.

units.label: Add [units] config table (agent/model/effort preferences)
units.description: Parses, merges, validates and finalizes a new [units] config table (agent choice, per-CLI model/effort), plus strip_units_section for `ktmr reset`, all with tests.

units.label: Report agent CLI availability in ktmr doctor
units.description: Adds a doctor section that probes for claude/codex on PATH via groups::agent, reusing the same resolution grouping itself uses so the report can't disagree with a live session.

units.label: Register ToggleUnits/RegenerateUnits/ToggleHints actions
units.description: Extends the Action enum, key bindings, name<->action lookups, help descriptions, and per-view no-op pass-through arms for the three new actions.

units.label: Add App-level unit-filter scoping (set/clear, rederive)
units.description: Introduces UnitFilter and App fields/methods to scope the diff view to one semantic unit's hunks, integrated into rederive/apply_scope_swap, with tests.

units.label: Add units panel overlay and first-use setup wizard
units.description: New src/ui/units_panel.rs (the grouping overlay) and units_setup.rs (one-time agent/model/effort picker) that render on top of the diff view.

units.label: Show active unit scope in the status bar
units.description: Adds a "unit N/M: label" indicator to the status bar when a unit filter is active.

units.label: Redesign status-bar hints as collapsed/expanded
units.description: Splits every view's hint bar into a minimal collapsed default and a full expanded list toggled by `.`, updating all call sites, unit tests, and e2e assertions that depended on the old always-expanded bar.

units.label: Wire units panel, setup wizard, and hints toggle into the event loop
units.description: ui/mod.rs: spawns/collects background grouping requests, intercepts the new actions, renders the units panel/banner/setup popup, and threads hints_expanded through layout and draw.

units.label: Wire units config into the CLI: dump-units, reset, app setup
units.description: main.rs: registers the groups module, adds hidden --dump-units/--regroup flags, a new `ktmr reset` command for units/cache/servers/comments state, and passes parsed [units] config into App.
